Description

Bug Report:

When VRChat is running in fullscreen mode on PC, mouse clicks sometimes do not register after Alt+Tabbing to another application (such as Chrome) or using the Windows key to switch windows. The new window appears to be in focus, but it behaves as if VRChat still has input focus. As a result, mouse clicks are ignored until I click again or wait briefly.

I used to be able to fix this by switching to Borderless Windowed mode, but that option was removed in the latest update. Now there is only a fullscreen option that can be toggled on or off with a checkbox.

I usually work while playing VRChat and often multitask between applications, so this has become a serious issue. I couldn't click on app when switch tab.
